subject: Invoice delivery orchestration & AP handoff for CloudScale (portal vs email)
messages:
From: CloudScale AP <ap@cloudscale.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Invoice delivery preference and VAT handling for Redwood invoices

Hi Markus,

We're finalizing our vendor onboarding for Redwood and need to confirm how you will deliver monthly invoices to us. Our AP system prefers e-invoices via our portal (Peppol + XML ingestion), but we can accept PDF copies via email if the portal integration isn't available.

Two specific asks:
- Can you send invoices via an automated SFTP/portal feed (preferred)? If so, please provide sample XML schema and endpoint details.
- If not, will Redwood send consolidated monthly PDFs to ap@cloudscale.com and include a billing contact for PO exceptions?

Also, we need to confirm VAT treatment for CloudScale (reverse charge or local VAT). I'll attach our AP intake requirements if helpful.

Thanks,
Jaya Patel
Senior AP Manager
CloudScale Systems
[Attachment: cloudscale_ap_requirements.pdf (pdf, 48KB)]

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: CloudScale AP <ap@cloudscale.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery preference and VAT handling for Redwood invoices

Hi Jaya — thanks for the note and the requirements doc. Short answer: we prefer to onboard customers onto our portal when possible but can support email PDF delivery as a fallback. Proposed approach:

1) Portal-first: our e-invoice feed can push invoices to customer endpoints (Peppol/SFTP/webhook) — we'll share an example XML payload and the endpoint configuration keys.
2) Email copies: for teams that need immediate receipts, we can send a monthly consolidated PDF to ap@cloudscale.com and cc your billing contact.
3) VAT: we will mark invoices per the tax form you supply; if CloudScale is VAT-registered and reverse-charge applies we'll leave VAT at 0% and include the VAT registration on the invoice.

Next steps:
- I've attached a simple billing_onboarding_matrix.xlsx that lists the pieces we need (preferred channel, sample endpoint, remit address, VAT reg #, PO exceptions).
- Can you confirm who at CloudScale should be marked as 'billing contact' for exception routing (name + email + phone)?

If portal integration is desired, Connor can pick this up to capture the technical endpoint details. Laura, can you confirm the signatory / bill-from name we should use for legal copy?

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: billing_onboarding_matrix.xlsx (xlsx, 24KB)]

From: Jaya Patel <jaya.patel@cloudscale.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: AP Team <ap@cloudscale.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 08:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery preference and VAT handling for Redwood invoices

Hi Markus — thanks, that workflow sounds good. A couple clarifications:

- We can accept Peppol if you are able to emit the UBL invoice; otherwise SFTP (SFTP push with daily pickup) is acceptable.
- Billing contact for exception routing: Priya Rao (priya.rao@cloudscale.com) — she'll triage.
- VAT: CloudScale is EU-registered for certain entities; for US contracts the reverse-charge won't apply. I'll attach our VAT certificate for the EU entity if you need it.

One operational ask: when you send the first invoice, please include a line-item description that maps to our cost center (we'll share the cost center code). We also sometimes require invoices to list the PO number in the invoice header to auto-apply. Can Redwood support a PO header field?

Appreciate it — happy to schedule a 20-min tech handoff if Connor needs to walk through the endpoint details.

Regards,
Jaya
[Attachment: cloudscale_vat_cert_eu.pdf (pdf, 16KB)]

From: connor_obrien@redwood.com
To: Jaya Patel <jaya.patel@cloudscale.com>, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery preference and VAT handling for Redwood invoices

Thanks Jaya — happy to run the tech handoff. A few specifics from our side:

- We can emit a Peppol UBL 2.1 payload or drop XML files via SFTP. Which do you prefer?
- PO header: yes, we have an invoice template variable for PO_NUMBER that we can populate if the PO is supplied at charge creation time or included as a header on our webhook.
- Cost center mapping: happy to include a free-text field that you can map client-side; if you provide the code we will put it in the line-item metadata.

Proposed mini agenda (20 min):
1) confirm channel (Peppol vs SFTP)
2) share sample payload and field mapping
3) exchange endpoint credentials / secure key process
4) test push + receipt acknowledgement

I'm available Tue/Thu mornings PST — would 11/10 09:30 PT work for a quick call?

Connor O'Brien
Platform Integrations Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Jaya Patel <jaya.patel@cloudscale.com>, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 15:06:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery orchestration & AP handoff for CloudScale (portal vs email)

Jaya / Connor — thanks for the quick back-and-forth. Finalizing on our side:

- Channel: we'll attempt Peppol UBL 2.1 first; fallback to SFTP if there are routing constraints.
- PO handling: mark the invoice with PO_NUMBER field when provided; we'll also place the PO on the invoice header to satisfy auto-ingest rules.
- Billing contact: we'll record Priya Rao as the exception contact and CC her on the first two monthly invoices.
- VAT: Laura — please confirm that the bill-from legal name on the PDF will be 'Redwood Inference, Inc.' and that our finance team will include VAT notes for EU entities when we receive the certificate.

Action items:
- Connor: send sample UBL + SFTP spec to ap@cloudscale.com and jaya.patel@cloudscale.com by COB 11/6.
- Jaya: send the cost center code and confirm preferred test date for the push.
- Laura: confirm bill-from legal name + attach signed MSO (I've attached signed-mso-terms.pdf we received today).

I'll open a billing onboarding ticket in Jira and copy the doc links. If all good, we'll do a short test push and then flip production.

Thanks,
Markus
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: signed-mso-terms.pdf (pdf, 72KB)]
